page.layout: One printed page: running head at top with page number left and title centred; a large heading below it; a woodcut engraving in the centre; a four-line... verse of six lines (italic) below the engraving; catchword-like word "INFERNI" at right foot.

main_text.head: O HOMO TIME, ET RESIPISCE.
main_text.p: [Woodcut engraving: devils leading a procession of the damned past burning buildings and gallows; not transcribed as text.]

page.notes: The woodcut is an illustration with no printed text inside it. The word "INFERNI" at the lower right is a printed catchword-like heading, placed as a line. Scan shows show-through and paper marks, which are omitted.
